from cachetools import LRUCache
c = LRUCache(3)
c['a'] = 1
c['b'] = 2
c['c'] = 3

# LRUCache doesn't auto-evict on __maxsize change. We need to do it manually.
# Check if popitem pops LRU
print('popitem:', c.popitem())  # LRU = 'a'
print('keys:', list(c.keys()))

# So resize needs to: shrink -> popitem until currsize <= maxsize
# grow -> just change maxsize (no eviction needed)

# Let's verify popitem always returns LRU
print('---')
c2 = LRUCache(3)
c2['a'] = 1
c2['b'] = 2
c2['c'] = 3
c2.get('b')  # refresh b
print('order:', list(c2._LRUCache__order.keys()))
print('popitem:', c2.popitem())  # should be 'a'
print('order:', list(c2._LRUCache__order.keys()))
